exclusions.note: No fish or shellfish, including anchovies. Fish sauce, shrimp paste, oyster sauce and Worcestershire sauce are fine, as is breaded or battered cod.
No mushrooms in any form, including stock and powder.
Household rule: no meat substitutes at all (Quorn, seitan, plant-based mince etc.).

No whole pieces of fruit, fresh or dried. Juice and zest are fine.
